scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @railmind/api" "npm run dev -w @railmind/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @railmind/contracts && npm run build -w @railmind/api && npm run build -w @railmind/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @railmind/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @railmind/api && npm run typecheck -w @railmind/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @railmind/api && npm run lint -w @railmind/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @railmind/api && npm run test -w @railmind/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:ml && npm run build
